body.heading: Set up your toy
paragraphs: Put paper on the ground in a sunny place and stand your toy at one edge.
The toy's shadow will fall across the paper like a grey picture of itself.

body.heading: Trace the shadow
paragraphs: Trace around the shadow slowly with your pencil. Shadows wriggle, so take your time.
Colour in your tracing. You have drawn with sunlight as your helper.

takeaway: A shadow is a drawing the light makes for you.
materials: A sunny spot or a torch
safetyNotes: Never look directly at the Sun; trace shadows on the paper, and let an adult hold the torch if you use one.
screenFreeExtension: Trace the same toy's shadow in the morning and the afternoon, and compare the two shapes.
